title: Complete smooth Gauss-Bonnet formalization beyond structure axioms

problemStatement.formal: \text{For a compact orientable Riemannian 2-manifold } M \text{ without boundary, prove } \int_M K\,dA = 2\pi\chi(M)\text{, with }\chi(M)=2-2g\text{ for closed orientable genus-}g\text{ surfaces.}
problemStatement.plain: Completion task for the gallery proof `euler-polyhedral-formula-oq-02-oq-01`. The existing local Lean file models smooth Gauss-Bonnet through structure fields such as `CompactRiemannianSurface.gauss_bonnet`, then proves many downstream consequences. This WIP asks for completion beyond that scaffold: identify whether the structure-encoded assumptions can be discharged, narrowed, or honestly documented against current Mathlib support.
whyMatters: Smooth Gauss-Bonnet is the bridge from local Gaussian curvature to the global Euler characteristic of a surface.

The parent gallery proof already proves useful consequences from axiomatized fields; completing this task would reduce the gap between an axiomatic interface and a first-principles Lean formalization.
Local evidence says Mathlib v4.26.0 lacks the Riemannian geometry infrastructure needed for a direct proof, so this problem is also a precise audit of the current library boundary.

proven: `Proofs/EulerPolyhedralOQ02OQ01.lean` (post S3 ACT 2026-06-10) contains the current smooth Gauss-Bonnet gallery formalization: 810 lines, 61 theorem declarations, 15 definitions/structures, no `sorry` tokens, and no top-level Lean `axiom` declarations.

S3 ACT (researcher-1, 2026-06-10, Docker-verified): Reduction D landed. `VectorFieldOnSurface.nonvanishing_index` is no longer a structural assumption; it is a derived theorem (proof: `Finset.sum_empty` after rewriting the zero set to `∅`). Parent `meta.json` `axiomCount` updated 10 → 9.

The downstream consequences include total curvature as a topological invariant, genus determination from total curvature, curvature-sign constraints, average curvature formulas, discrete/smooth agreement checks, Girard-style triangle consequences, Poincare-Hopf consequences, and Morse-theory consequences.
`proofs/Proofs.lean` imports `Proofs.EulerPolyhedralOQ02OQ01`, so the source proof is wired into the local proof index.
open: The core smooth Gauss-Bonnet theorem is not proved from Mathlib Riemannian geometry; it is encoded as the `CompactRiemannianSurface.gauss_bonnet` structure field (DEEP).

Local proof metadata (post S3 ACT) records 9 remaining structure-encoded assumptions: Gauss-Bonnet, chi/genus classification, Chern-Gauss-Bonnet, boundary, polygon, constant-curvature, triangle, Poincaré-Hopf, Morse relation. 6 are DEEP (Mathlib-blocked); 3 remain TRACTABLE (polygon, constant-curvature, triangle) and are scheduled for S4/S5 ACT (Reductions B/C).

The 6 DEEP assumptions await Mathlib infrastructure: Riemannian metrics + 2-form integration on oriented manifolds (gauss_bonnet, gauss_bonnet_boundary), surface classification (chi_genus), vector bundles with connection + Pfaffian of curvature 2-form (chern_gauss_bonnet), vector-field/singularity index theory (poincare_hopf), Morse theory + CW-decomposition (morse_relation).

(S3 ACT 2026-06-10: Reduction D discharged → axiomCount 10 → 9. Next: Reductions B, C.)

insights: The source problem is a completion target for the smooth Gauss-Bonnet proof, not a separate arithmetic or sieve problem.

The current source proof is `Proofs/EulerPolyhedralOQ02OQ01.lean` in namespace `SmoothGaussBonnet`; it wraps the headline formula as `CompactRiemannianSurface.gauss_bonnet : totalCurvature = 2 * pi * chi`.

The proof file has no `sorry` tokens and no top-level `axiom` declarations, but the mathematical assumptions are embedded as structure fields, so the right completion target is de-axiomatization or precise blocker documentation.

The parent gallery metadata reports 10 structure-encoded assumptions and identifies the proof status as axiomatized, with Mathlib v4.26.0 lacking Riemannian metrics, Gaussian curvature, and integration on manifolds.

S2 inventory (2026-06-09): all 10 assumptions located by line number. 6 DEEP (Mathlib-blocked on Riemannian geometry / vector bundles / Morse theory): gauss_bonnet (L56), chi_genus (L67), chern_gauss_bonnet (L340), gauss_bonnet_boundary (L463), poincare_hopf (L638), morse_relation (L711). 4 TRACTABLE (reducible from current Mathlib + clever structuring): gauss_bonnet_polygon (L486, derivable from #4 via toBoundary coercion), curvature_is_K_area (L494, pure measure theory via setIntegral_const), gauss_bonnet_triangle (L542, derivable from polygon GB at n=3), nonvanishing_index (L640, derivable from Finset.sum_empty if noZeros is operationalized).

S2 cost-ordered reduction plan: D (nonvanishing_index, ~5 LOC, low risk) > B (gauss_bonnet_polygon, ~10 LOC, medium risk) > C (gauss_bonnet_triangle, ~15 LOC, depends on B) > skip A (curvature_is_K_area — clean reduction blocked by needing #4 first; better to relabel as definition than to reduce).

S3 ACT result (2026-06-10): Reduction D landed. The cheapest concrete representation of an isolated-zero set that lets `nonvanishing_index` become derivable is `zeros : Finset ℕ` (index labels) + `indexAt : ℕ → ℤ` (index value at each label), with `totalIndex := ∑ i ∈ zeros, indexAt i` and `noZeros := zeros = ∅`. The previous `noZeros : Prop` field carried zero mathematical content but functioned as an assumption shadow because `nonvanishing_index : noZeros → totalIndex = 0` was a free field; once the zero set is explicit, `Finset.sum_empty` discharges the field. The downstream hairy-ball-style theorems are unaffected because they only consume `nonvanishing_index` via the original API.

S3 audit note: the new structure has 4 fields where the old one had 5; the only remaining VectorFieldOnSurface assumption is `poincare_hopf : (∑ i ∈ zeros, indexAt i) = surface.chi`, which is the genuine deep Poincaré-Hopf identity (still DEEP, awaiting vector-field/singularity infrastructure in Mathlib). The structure-encoded assumption count for the file drops from 10 to 9 by removing exactly `nonvanishing_index`; no other field was added or modified, so the deep-assumption set is unchanged.

Reduction B required reversing the S2 sketch: a def GeodesicPolygon.toBoundary built from loose polygon fields would need the very Gauss-Bonnet identity being dropped (circular). The sound encoding embeds CompactSurfaceWithBoundary INTO GeodesicPolygon with chi_eq_one : chi = 1, identifying exteriorAngleSum with boundaryGeodCurv definitionally (geodesic arcs contribute zero smooth curvature).

# Knowledge Base: euler-polyhedral-formula-oq-02-oq-01-wip-01

## Problem Understanding

This is a WIP completion task for `euler-polyhedral-formula-oq-02-oq-01`, the smooth Gauss-Bonnet gallery proof. The mathematical target is the closed orientable surface formula `int_M K dA = 2*pi*chi(M)`, with `chi(M) = 2 - 2g` for genus `g`.

The existing local proof is not scaffold-only. After S3 ACT (researcher-1, 2026-06-10), `Proofs/EulerPolyhedralOQ02OQ01.lean` is an 810-line axiomatic development in namespace `SmoothGaussBonnet`; it has 61 theorem declarations, 15 definitions/structures, no `sorry` tokens, and no top-level Lean `axiom` declarations. The key caveat is that the central geometric facts are still carried as structure fields, especially `CompactRiemannianSurface.gauss_bonnet : totalCurvature = 2 * pi * chi`.

## Reduction history

- S3 ACT (2026-06-10): Reduction D landed. Restructured `VectorFieldOnSurface` so its zero set is recorded explicitly (`zeros : Finset ℕ`, `indexAt : ℕ → ℤ`), made `noZeros` and `totalIndex` derived definitions, and discharged the old `nonvanishing_index` field as a theorem via `Finset.sum_empty`. Parent meta.json `axiomCount: 10 → 9`. Docker-verified.

## Local Evidence

- `problem.md` says this WIP was created to complete the smooth Gauss-Bonnet theorem proof in the gallery source `euler-polyhedral-formula-oq-02-oq-01`.
- `state.md` records phase progression OBSERVE (S1) → ORIENT (S2) → ACT (S3).
- `src/data/proofs/euler-polyhedral-formula-oq-02-oq-01/meta.json` (post-S3) marks the source proof as `axiomatized`, reports 0 sorries, 810 lines, 61 theorems, 15 definitions, and 9 structure-encoded assumptions.
- `proofs/Proofs.lean` imports `Proofs.EulerPolyhedralOQ02OQ01`.

## Current Completion Target

Next useful work: S4 ACT (Reduction B) — derive `gauss_bonnet_polygon` from `gauss_bonnet_boundary` via a `GeodesicPolygon.toBoundary` coercion. ~10 LOC. Would bring assumption count to 8.

## Mathlib Boundary

The local proof comments and metadata say Mathlib v4.26.0 lacks Riemannian metrics, Gaussian curvature, integration on manifolds, differential forms, vector bundles with connection, and Morse theory support at the level needed for a first-principles proof. These remain the 6 DEEP assumptions that gate the badge from `axiomatized` to `verified`.
